svg.text: Portable ML IR Layer - MLIR Dialects + Versioning + Serialization - openxla.org/stablehlo
L1 - Framework Producers (emit StableHLO / CHLO programs)
L2 - MLIR Dialect Stack (companion + versioned dialects)
Higher-level sugar ops - decompose to StableHLO core opset
Staging area before ops graduate into StableHLO spec
Community-owned portable IR - spec + reference impl
~100 HLO ops - closed set - framework/compiler contract
Add-only dialect snapshots at each minor version bump
Historical HLO in XLA - StableHLO evolved from MHLO
Legalize MHLO - StableHLO for neutral portability layer
L3 - StableHLO Core IR (types, ops, attrs, functions)
Static shapes primary - dynamic shape ops supported
Shape inference rules per op in spec
Closed opset - each op has spec semantics + reference impl + compatibility rules
Precision config - conv/d dot dims - window attrs
MLIR syntax for max framework/compiler interop
L4 - Compiler Pass Pipeline (MLIR transforms in stablehlo repo)
StableHLO program survives version skew between producer and consumer
Step 1: Framework builds MLIR module with StableHLO/CHLO ops
Step 2: CHLO decompose pass - sugar ops lowered to StableHLO core
Step 3: Legalize StableHLO - VHLO snapshot at current version (add-only)
Step 4: Serialize to MLIR bytecode (.mlirbc) or text (.mlir) artifact
Step 5: Deserialize - VHLO upgrade/downgrade - legalize back to StableHLO
Guarantee: older consumer reads newer artifact via VHLO downgrade + upgrade chain
Reference interpreter executes spec semantics for validation and testing
StableHLO is the portability contract between producers and compilers
Frameworks produce StableHLO - Compilers consume StableHLO - VHLO enables evolution without breaking artifacts
Defragments ML toolchain: one neutral IR contract on MLIR between JAX/TF/PyTorch and XLA/IREE/edge
Community-owned opset - not tied to single compiler - evolves via RFC + spec + compat tests
Interoperability - Versioned evolution - Spec-defined semantics - MLIR-native - Framework/compiler neutrality
Init path: framework export - CHLO decompose - StableHLO module - optional VHLO legalize - serialize artifact
Step path: deserialize bytecode - VHLO upgrade - StableHLO - compiler passes - XLA/IREE/edge codegen
Sources: openxla.org/stablehlo/spec - github.com/openxla/stablehlo - compatibility.md - bytecode.md - v1.0 RFC
